steps.body: Your fingers are always with you. Hold up one group on one hand and the other group on the other hand.
steps.narration: Your fingers are always with you. Hold up one group on one hand and the other group on the other hand.

widget.prompt: Show 4 fingers and 2 fingers on the frame. How many in all?

commonCounts.feedback: That shows one hand only. The other hand's 2 fingers count too.

widget.missFeedback: Fill one square at a time, counting as you go, until the frame shows the number you need.

predict.prompt: You hold up 4 fingers on one hand and 2 on the other. How many are up?
predict.reveal: Both hands count. Starting from one and counting every raised finger gives 6 — 4 is what you would have if the other hand were empty.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents koa fingers.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for koa fingers must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines koa fingers.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Both hands together show the total.

widget.prompt: Hold up 4 fingers on one hand and 2 on the other. How many fingers are up?
